summary: A full packet whose last traded timestamp is in epoch seconds: the desktop sends ltt and last_trade_time in epoch ms, the web passes the seconds on.

deviations.reason: mStock's full packet carries the last traded time in epoch seconds (web test/test_mstock_quote_feed.py: last_traded_timestamp=1730783990 beside an exchange timestamp in ms); the web sends it as ltt unconverted, in seconds, while feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends it in ms (brokers/mstock/streaming.rs trade_time_ms).
As ltt: the web's last_trade_time for a full packet is the raw epoch seconds; the desktop's mStock last_trade_time alias carries ltt's value in epoch ms.
deviations.ref: mstock_adapter.py:355; feed::dialect (mStock last_trade_time in ms, openalgo#2383)

deviations.reason: The web also sends mStock's exchange timestamp under its own name, in every mode, whenever the packet carries one (mstock_adapter.py:357-358). The desktop's renderer has the name for mStock (feed/dialect/names.rs MSTOCK, QuoteExtras::exchange_time_ms) but MstockFeed does not fill it yet: phase B sets it from the packet's exchange timestamp when it is not 0.

The web sends the full packet's upper circuit limit in Depth (mstock_adapter.py:425). The desktop decodes it (brokers/mstock/streaming.rs Packet::upper_circuit) and the renderer has the name for mStock (feed/dialect/names.rs CIRCUITS_IN_DEPTH), but MstockFeed does not fill QuoteExtras::upper_circuit yet; on a Quote frame cut from a full packet the web sends it too (the one-dict fan-out, C08), which lane wire's step 2 brings.
As upper_circuit, for the lower circuit limit (mstock_adapter.py:426; Packet::lower_circuit).
